# अहमेदी सैलून · Ahmedi Salon (full reference for LLMs)

> An always-on, synchronised street-corner radio playing 90s Bollywood film songs, inspired by Deluxe Salon.

## What it is
Ahmedi Salon is a full-stack, self-hostable radio station. Every listener tuned
in at the same moment hears the same track at the same position, because a
server-driven station clock seek-syncs each client. When a track ends, the
server advances and broadcasts the next one to all clients. Audio is streamed
through YouTube's embedded player; nothing is hosted on the site, and all
rights to the music, films and recordings remain with their owners.

- Live: https://ahmedisalon.nabilahmed.in
- Source: https://github.com/nabilaameena/Ahmedi-Salon
- Built by Nabil: https://nabilahmed.in
- License: MIT (code); music/film rights remain with their owners

## Features
- Synchronised radio (server clock seek-syncs all listeners)
- Live presence (concurrent listener count over WebSocket)
- Song requests (vote tally; most-requested track plays next)
- Listener wall (live chat broadcast to everyone)
- Four rotations of 60 tracks, auto-picked by IST hour
- Now Playing full screen, live reactions/emotes, shareable "now playing" card
- Admin controls (token-protected skip + force-rotation)
- PWA (installable, service worker, manifest)
- Day/night reactive backdrop matching the current rotation

## Rotations (by hour, India / IST)
- 05:00–09:00 — Shaadi & Sunday
- 09:00–18:00 — Saloon Classics
- 18:00–22:00 — 90s Dard
- 22:00–05:00 — Highway Raat

## Catalogue
133 songs, 1986 to 2001, each with a Hindi title (Devanagari), a Romanised
title, the film, the artist and the year. Songs are requested by tapping them
in the Songs view; the station plays the most-requested track next. The full
list is in the source file `src/data.js`.

## Architecture
- Front end: Vite + vanilla JS (no framework), frosted-glass UI, PWA
- Back end: Node + Express + `ws` WebSocket station server
  - REST: `/api/state`, `/api/songs`, `/api/rotations`, `/api/schedule`,
    `/api/requests`, `/api/stats`, `/api/request`, `/api/admin/*`
  - WebSocket: `/ws` (station, presence, requests, chat, reactions)
- Synchronisation: server keeps `startedAt` (ms); clients seek to
  `(now - startedAt) / 1000`; clients report `track:ended` to advance
- Persistence: JSON file (durations, chat, listen counts, peak)
- Dockerized, single self-contained service on port 8080

## How to run
- Docker: `docker compose up --build -d` → http://localhost:8080
- Dev: `npm run install:all && npm run dev` (server :8080, web :5173)
- Without Docker: `npm run install:all && npm run build && PORT=8080 npm --prefix server start`
- Admin token: set `ADMIN_TOKEN` env var (default `saloon`; change it)
